column7: The OUTPOST has a storage limit
*Don’t expect to gain by doing others harm
*Don’t collude with your partners to shut down major parts of game play
*DRIVE COACHES, SCORING ELEMENTS are off limits
*DRIVE COACHES and other teams: hands off the controls
*Only the ALLIANCE CAPTAIN may invite an ALLIANCE
*BACKUP TEAMS due 2 minutes before the MATCH start time
*Create new designs and software, unless they’re public
*Only specified modifications to control system devices permitted
*Limit what you use during a MATCH
Only score while in your ALLIANCE ZONE
*Communicate with the ROBOT with the specified radio
*Only use specified circuit breakers in a PD
*Only use allowed ports and bandwidth to communicate with the ROBOT
*Battery limit – everyone has the same power
*Control PCM, PH, and Servo Hub from roboRIO
*Other batteries for cameras or computers only
*Control CAN motor controllers from the roboRIO
*No custom pneumatics and meet minimum pressure ratings
*Teams may not enable their ROBOTS on the FIELD
*Asking other teams to throw a MATCH – not cool
*Letting someone coerce you into throwing a MATCH – also not cool
*The ROBOT frame is not a wire
*Must be able to turn ROBOT on and off safely
*Only approved MXP devices can control actuators
*If using pneumatics, these parts are required
*The OPERATOR CONSOLE must have a visible display
*Connect FMS Ethernet directly to the OPERATOR CONSOLE
